$comment: The skills library index. scripts/check-library.sh verifies every entry against the files on disk, and scripts/spawn.sh reads `needs` and `default_for` to pick what a new project gets. `needs` are the answers of the questionnaire in docs/questionnaire.md. `default_for` names repo kinds whose presence installs the entry without being asked. `supersedes` names entries a selected entry removes, so a domain keeps one source.

needs.prose: every session writes prose: commit messages, docs, replies
needs.self-improvement: friction noticed during work becomes a skill candidate
needs.discovery: search the open skills ecosystem for what is missing
needs.code-quality: a simplification pass on every diff
needs.security: pattern check on every edit, review of every diff and commit
needs.skill-authoring: write or evaluate skills of your own
needs.browser-testing: drive a local web app with playwright-cli
needs.ui: static UI guidance: style, color, type, layout
needs.ui-review: a merge gate on UI code: accessibility, focus, forms, performance
needs.components: one library per UI task, each pick a recorded decision
needs.motion: animation and interaction, plus a merge gate for it
needs.design: screens mocked up in the ops repo before they are built, under a design director with deterministic rules; replaces the default static UI source
needs.conversion: audit a page or form that already exists
needs.activation: the path from paid to first value
needs.experiments: design an A/B test before a change ships as one
needs.outbound: cold outreach: a qualified prospect list, cold email that gets replies, replies scored and routed
needs.cloudflare: operate the front ends on Cloudflare: Workers, Wrangler, DNS, domains
needs.board: specs as cards on the Notion product board, read and moved by every session that builds
needs.completion: substantial work finished against written, runnable gates and proven before the done report
needs.validation: test the business before money goes in: a board, competitors, simulated buyers, price, offer, unit economics, marketing, brand, operations, launch, the business plan

entries.name: stop-slop
entries.summary: Removes AI writing patterns from every piece of prose.

entries.name: task-observer
entries.summary: Watches each session for corrections and methodology worth keeping as skills. Log pinned inside the repo because the container is ephemeral.

entries.name: find-skills
entries.summary: Finds installable skills for a need nothing here covers. `npx skills find <query>` reached skills.sh from the web container on 2026-10-22, with install counts; when a network policy blocks it, search GitHub instead.

entries.name: mem
entries.summary: Hierarchical memory at .claude/memory/, committed to git.

entries.name: product-board
entries.summary: The Notion product board protocol: read the spec on the card, move the card from Ready to Live as pull requests open, staging turns green and the founder says go. The board's structure is docs/board.md in mainBrain; the project's links are in the ops CLAUDE.md.

entries.name: unlazy
entries.summary: Completion discipline for substantial work: GATES.md before the work, runnable CHECK/EXPECT gates, the Depth Tree, independent leaves as parallel background subagents, no done report until the ledger is met. Node scripts, no dependency. The Stop hook is opt-in and never installed by the generator.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: the ledger stays out of git and goes in the pull request body, the card's Test section and the repo's checks become gates, a session approves only checks it wrote, any other waits for the founder's yes, parallel subagents are authorized in every repo.

entries.name: write-spec
entries.summary: Writes a spec onto the product board: a global card and one sub-card per screen, Project, Stage Ready, the App Spec template, every action, state and rule, a capture per screen. Triggers on a request for a spec or a Claude Design mockup to turn into cards. Self-contained, so the same folder uploads to claude.ai as a ZIP; without Notion (Claude Design) it hands over paste-ready cards.

entries.name: code-simplifier
entries.summary: Simplification pass on every code change before commit. Invoked as an agent, never loaded as a skill.
entries.local_change_note: The 'Apply Project Standards' list points at each repo's CLAUDE.md instead of another project's conventions.

entries.name: security-guidance
entries.summary: Pattern check on every edit, model review of the diff at the end of every turn, agentic review on every commit and push. Its repo rules are the two harness files.

entries.name: ui-ux-pro-max
entries.summary: The single source of static UI guidance. Do not enable a second one (frontend-design, taste-skill): two advisors on one task produce two aesthetics. impeccable replaces it in a project that takes the design need.

entries.name: impeccable
entries.summary: Design director for mockups and screens: a mode per surface (Operate, Persuade, Read), a craft floor of absolute bans, critique and audit, 24 commands, and an engine whose detector fails on design anti-patterns (exit 2). Drives the ops design/ folder and its check.sh.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: context files are docs/product.md and docs/design-system.md, never a root PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md; static UI is its own, motion goes through animate, copy through BRAND.md; telemetry off, no hook, no pin; variants as sibling mockups. The launcher checks the engine download against scripts/engine.sha256, pinned here.

entries.name: cloudflare
entries.summary: Cloudflare's own skills (Workers, Wrangler, web performance, Turnstile) and its MCP server for the whole Cloudflare API. The server takes the API token the environment holds as a network secret (HANDOFF C3); without one it asks for OAuth, which a cloud session cannot complete.

entries.name: web-design-guidelines
entries.summary: Merge gate on any site or app pull request that touches UI: about 100 rules on accessibility, focus, forms, performance and i18n, checked in code, findings as file:line. Rules vendored in command.md, never fetched.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: read command.md instead of fetching; accessibility, focus, forms and anti-pattern findings block; review-animations, BRAND.md and the static UI source (ui-ux-pro-max, or impeccable) keep their domains.

entries.name: pick-ui-library
entries.summary: Picks one library per UI task (primitives, toasts, command menu, charts, virtualization, drag and drop, state). disable-model-invocation upstream, so Claude reads it by path; animate sends component work here.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: a pick is a decision line before install; React picks go to the app; next-themes skipped; motion rows go through animate.

entries.name: skill-creator
entries.summary: Create, edit and evaluate skills. Needs python3.

entries.name: playwright-cli
entries.summary: Drives a local web app from the shell: open, click, type, snapshot with element refs, screenshots, traces, video, request mocking, test generation. Node, no script to write.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum on the web container: pinned 0.1.22 installed by the setup script, Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium passed on open, output in /tmp, serve over http, no gh for attachments.

entries.name: animate
entries.summary: Builds motion and interaction. Pairs with review-animations.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: the static UI source (ui-ux-pro-max, or impeccable) owns static UI; sample curves are examples, not tokens; an animation library is a recorded decision.

entries.name: review-animations
entries.summary: Merge gate on any site or app pull request that touches motion. disable-model-invocation upstream, so Claude reads it by path; a Block verdict stops the merge.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: when it runs, Tailwind default durations and easings accepted until motion tokens exist, motion only.

entries.name: copywriting
entries.summary: Conversion copy for public pages.

entries.name: cro
entries.summary: Audits a page or form that already exists. Form CRO is a reference inside it.

entries.name: prospecting
entries.summary: Turns an ICP into a verified, scored lead sheet: sources, enrichment, email verification, account research, and the compliance posture of each source. Its compliance reference is the line on scraping: a business's own site yes, bulk extraction from Maps, Yelp or LinkedIn no.

entries.name: cold-email
entries.summary: Cold email and its follow-ups: frameworks, personalization, subject lines, cadence, deliverability, reply handling. The one advisor on outbound sending; no second sequencer joins it.

entries.name: revops
entries.summary: Lead lifecycle stages with entry and exit rules, fit-plus-engagement scoring, routing and handoff. Qualifies what outbound brings in.

entries.name: signup
entries.summary: Self-serve account creation flow.

entries.name: onboarding
entries.summary: A customer's path from paid to first value.

entries.name: ab-testing
entries.summary: Designs an experiment before a change ships as a test.

entries.name: founder-board
entries.summary: Entry point of the Founder skill pack: writes founder/idea.md, then three board subagents score the idea through three published frameworks, name what would kill it and vote. The eleven founder-* skills share founder/ at the ops repo root and run board, competitors, consumer, pricing, offer, cfo, marketing, brand, ops, launch, plan.

entries.name: founder-competitors
entries.summary: Direct and indirect competitors and substitutes from public sources, every fact linked: prices, positioning, review complaints, the gap to own. Reads pages, never scrapes.

entries.name: founder-consumer
entries.summary: A panel of simulated buyers (100, or 20 with --quick), one subagent each in waves of ten, dealt by panel.py from the target customer; who buys, who passes and why. The buy rate is an upper bound, panel quotes are never testimonials.

entries.name: founder-pricing
entries.summary: Van Westendorp range from the panel's price answers or a real survey (van_westendorp.py), set against competitors and the margin: a price, a ladder, an opening offer to test.

entries.name: founder-offer
entries.summary: The offer stack that answers the panel's objections (bonuses, an affordable guarantee, real urgency, a name), scored on the value equation and re-tested on a quick panel.

entries.name: founder-cfo
entries.summary: Unit economics from one JSON (unit_economics.py): contribution, margin, break-even, year 1 by month, cash needed, payback, what-ifs. A missing input is an error, never a guess.

entries.name: founder-marketing
entries.summary: Positioning, channels, a dated 30-day launch campaign, ten hooks, the budget and the most a customer may cost, each message answering a buyer objection.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: it plans, copywriting writes the pages under BRAND.md; hooks follow BRAND.md once it exists, drafts until then.

entries.name: founder-brand
entries.summary: Name candidates with the trademark, domain and handle checks to run, a promise, a voice and a brief for the look.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: founder/brand.md is a proposal, BRAND.md stays the founder's; the look is a brief for the design source, never a token; ui-ux-pro-max keeps static UI.

entries.name: founder-ops
entries.summary: How the business runs on day one: suppliers and costs, staffing, routines, tools, permits to check, a risk register; real costs go back to the CFO.

entries.name: founder-launch
entries.summary: A cheap real-world test first, then a dated countdown, the launch-day run sheet and the first 30 days.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: a test page is a card on the board built through the workflow; product work stays on the board; prod stays the founder's go.

entries.name: founder-plan
entries.summary: Compiles founder/ into one business plan (compile.py) with a verdict computed from the numbers: Profitable, Not yet or Incomplete. Plus a summary and a one-pager.
